## Preflight

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| main | `98ee0202499ba87fa4ee13d58a2a9075016225bd`, equal to source_main |
| Newest authority | CG-DIR-F9-001 (6240051686). The other two messages after H1's RETURN are a non-authority receipt (6240049267, H1 RETURN consumed) and CG-REVIEW-KF155-006 (6240050804), which asks for no worker mutation. Nothing newer. |
| Selector | `select-directive.mjs` over the full #80 collection selects CG-DIR-F9-001, with 0 rejected |
| Status | `status.mjs --verify`: CONSISTENT, generation 118 of 118. The active application packet is still KF-EXEC-AUTH-FAIL-CLOSED-001 (FIXING_PROOF_FAILURES), with merge authority false |
| H1 | RETURN 6230685195 was posted and consumed. No H1 process or worktree is in use. PR 179 is not touched. |
| Ownership | No branch, PR or worktree for this packet existed. A fresh worker worktree (`worker-worktrees/CG-DIR-F9-001`) is on the new ordinary branch `impl/kf-meta-merge-authority-001` from source_main. The interactive checkout is not used. |
| Baseline | `node --test scripts/agent-control/tests/*.spec.mjs` on main: 492/492 passed, 0 skipped (Node 20.18.1) |

## F9 reproduced locally (no network, no merge call)

I ran the packaged probes from 11971802 against a read-only LF checkout of 98ee0202. The probe hashes need LF line endings, and this host's checkout uses CRLF.
- matrix: **12 unsafe accepts**, 6 preserved denials, as recorded.
- gate step: exits **0 / 0 / 1** for ACCEPT_FOR_ADMISSION / READY_TO_MERGE / CORRECTION_REQUIRED, with both artifact grants false.
- CLI probe: **NOT_RUN on this host.** `run-cli-probe.mjs` passes a bare `C:\...` path to `--import`, and Node rejects it with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME before the source runs. I did not edit the probe. The CLI path will be reproduced instead by this packet's own synthetic-fetch CLI test. That test runs first on unmodified code, where it must show the mocked merge PUT.

## F9 writer/consumer map

| Role | Where | Today |
|---|---|---|
| Decision writer (authority) | ChatGPT REVIEW on #80 | the only real grant. 6111001643 (PR 159) is the shape: REVIEW, NO_STATE_CHANGE, merge_authority true, review_status READY_TO_MERGE, pr_number, pr_head, source_head, source_main, packet_id, branch |
| Artifact writer (builder) | `.agent-control/claude-return.yaml` `review_status` / `merge_authority` | builder-controlled; read as authority today |
| Parser | `lib/control-envelope.mjs` `collectAuthority` | allowlist, edits, order. **Unchanged** |
| Effect reader | `lib/authority-effects.mjs` `readEffect` | typed effect + production_touched. **Unchanged**, reused read-only |
| Consumer 1: evaluator | `lib/admission.mjs` `evaluateAdmission` | `READY_STATUSES` accepts both statuses; never reads a grant |
| Consumer 2: recheck | `lib/admission.mjs` `recheckBeforeMerge` | compares head/base only |
| Consumer 3: collector/merger | `auto-merge-admitted.mjs` (`--merge` from the autopilot event and hourly jobs) | collects no #80 grant or hold |
| Consumer 4: non-draft gate | `agent-control-gate.yml`, step "Require ChatGPT admission before non-draft merge readiness" | `sed` on the artifact status |
| Not a consumer | programme-state / reducer / DAG | the merge path does not read them, and this stays so |

## Scoped plan

1. **`lib/merge-grant.mjs`**, the one shared predicate: `evaluateMergeGrant(comments, target)`. It is pure, and it reads only through `collectAuthority` / `envelopeField` / `readEffect`. Target = {repository, pr_number, packet_id, branch, source_head, pr_head, base_sha}.
   - A collection that is unverified (edited, unknown edit state, unordered, unobserved) denies.
   - grant = valid REVIEW from an allowlisted author with `merge_authority: true` and `review_status: READY_TO_MERGE`. `control_effect` must be read by `readEffect` as NO_STATE_CHANGE or PACKET_ADMISSION. All six target fields must match exactly (40-hex). A `repository` field, if one is present, must equal the target. The repository binding is otherwise the source: only this repository's #80 is read.
   - ACCEPT_FOR_ADMISSION, a semantic PASS, NO_STATE_CHANGE alone and the artifact flags are never a grant.
   - Ordering: the newest message about this PR, packet or branch must be the grant. A later valid one of any type, or a later malformed one that is or may be about the target, voids it (stale/revoked). A HOLD on the target packet with no later RESUME for it denies, whichever side of the grant it falls. Holds on other packets do not apply, so the unrelated active packet neither blocks nor moves. No global READY_TO_MERGE is required.
2. **`evaluateAdmission`** takes `control_comments` + `repository` and checks the grant **last**. Every existing denial keeps its reason, and failover, binding, base, tail, workflow freshness and transitions all stay. Its eligible evidence carries the grant (comment id, message id, binding).
3. **`recheckBeforeMerge`** denies when the two snapshots name different grants (id or binding), as well as on head/base change.
4. **`auto-merge-admitted.mjs`** collects every page of #80 in each of the two fresh snapshots. A new `--grant-only` mode evaluates only the PR, its artifacts and the shared predicate. It reads no workflows, so the gate never waits on itself.
5. **Gate step**: keep the existing source_main and status checks, then run `auto-merge-admitted.mjs --grant-only`. It must also match the event's head and base SHAs. **Disclosure:** reading #80 from this workflow needs `issues: read` added to its top-level `permissions` (read-only; outside the step body itself). I treat this as part of the allowed gate change. If you rule otherwise, I will stop that piece and post a CONTRADICTION.
6. **Acyclic binding**: the grant names the final artifact head after that artifact exists, and the artifact never names the grant. The order of operations is grant, then ready transition, then gate run, then evaluator. I will document it.
7. **Tests**: predicate unit cases for every rejecting case in the directive, the preserved 159-shape meta grant and an application grant. Evaluator and recheck cases. A real CLI test spawns `auto-merge-admitted.mjs --merge` under a preloaded synthetic `fetch` (no passthrough; unexpected requests throw) for: no grant (no PUT), valid grant (one mocked PUT), grant revoked between snapshots (no PUT), and `--grant-only`. Focused live negative controls go in `negative-controls.yaml`. Every original regression stays.
8. **Docs**: AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE.md merge-protection section, AGENT_AUTOPILOT.md eligibility list, and the F9 record. The residual races go in explicitly: comment changes are not atomic with the SHA-pinned PUT, and the shared account limits attestation.

Then the full suite, CLI proof, negative controls, both DAG validators, artifact checks, and exact-head workflows. Then a draft PR, then one RETURN. No merge, no ready transition, merge_authority false, credit ZERO.
